def find_ancestors(node, reverse_graph):
    ancestors = []
    visited = set()
    stack = [node]
    
    while stack:
        current = stack.pop()
        for parent in reverse_graph.get(current, []):
            if parent not in visited:
                visited.add(parent)
                ancestors.append(parent)
                stack.append(parent)
    
    return ancestors
